fixture_definitions.reason_precedence: Order rejection of present02 after absent/rejected01 precedes any02 semantic validation. Absent02 remains unavailable even after invalid01. Whole-verifier failure overrides all checkpoint state projections.
fixture_definitions.timing_qualification: worker_status success is adversarial timing metadata in several fixtures; presence defined only by explicit fixture columns.
